name: GLEIF LEI data
finding: Accounting parent relationship does not prove ownership percentage; use LEI as entity bridge.

name: OpenSanctions
finding: Sanctions aggregation shares upstream lists; overlap cannot independently corroborate a listing.

name: INTERPOL Red Notices
finding: Wanted-person notice is not conviction; officer identity and current notice status require exact biographical proof.

name: IRS FATCA Foreign Financial Institution list
finding: FATCA registration can supply a narrow institution-status check, never proof of a financial transaction.

name: EU Cohesion Open Data
finding: Regional cohesion allocations versus prosperity need beneficiary geography, eligibility formula and population denominators.

name: Grants.gov APIs
finding: Opportunity notices do not establish awards; procurement lifecycle IDs and actual award decisions are missing.

name: UNOOSA Register of Objects Launched into Outer Space
finding: Space registration and catalog designators permit piece-level comparison after authority and historical coverage checks.

name: CelesTrak GP orbital data
finding: Orbit catalog provides object identifiers but current elements do not demonstrate past operations.

name: Space-Track.org
finding: Space-Track supplies orbital catalog data under its own registration/terms. Cross-check full object identifiers and observation epoch with CelesTrak, recognizing potentially shared upstream observations; not independent proof of satellite operation. Earlier checkpoint mistakenly described this source as radio allocation.

name: IMF PortWatch
finding: Modeled port activity and customs trade use different quantities and timing; vessel cargo evidence needed.

name: ReliefWeb API
finding: ReliefWeb republishes upstream reports; distinguish original evidence from duplicate publication.

name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
finding: Imagery is an auxiliary observation; specific site, usable acquisition date and clouds must be established.

name: USGS Landsat data
finding: Historical imagery requires repeat acquisitions and compatible resolution before a change-detection test.

name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine APIs
finding: Archive capture time is not the publication or underlying event date; missing captures cannot prove absence.

name: World Bank Documents & Reports API
finding: World Bank project ID links document and project indexes; text retrieval confirmed, substantive delivery comparison still auxiliary.

name: OONI data and API
finding: OONI supports censorship-specific tests rather than general outage inference; control false positives and geography.

name: HydroSHEDS
finding: Drainage topology is a necessary auxiliary for downstream tailings scenarios, not a hazard footprint.

name: GRACE Tellus gravity and groundwater data
finding: GRACE basin-scale mass estimates cannot attribute facility-level water extraction; hydrologic balance and scale bridge missing.

name: UNHCR Refugee Data Finder API
finding: Country-year displacement totals cannot identify local incident effects without disaggregation and reporting coverage.

name: ORCID Public API
finding: ORCID is partly self-asserted; author identity bridge needs corroboration, not guilt by affiliation.

name: OpenFIGI API
finding: FIGI identifies an instrument, not its ultimate legal owner; issuer and dated beneficial-owner bridges are required.

name: US Energy Information Administration API
finding: EPA advertises an EIA facility crosswalk; generation/emissions comparisons require unit boundaries and fuel mix.

name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform API
finding: Unit generation may test purported closure after EIC-to-asset crosswalk, token and actual-versus-forecast checks.

name: Statistics Canada Reference Data as a Service
finding: Industry classifications contextualize companies; category overlap alone is no consequential hypothesis.

name: House of Commons of Canada open data
finding: Voting and donations need member-to-recipient, election-cycle and legislative-subject links; sequence does not prove influence.

name: Toronto Stock Exchange / TMX Datalinx market-data products
finding: Market reference access and price/history rights must be confirmed before event comparisons.

name: System for Electronic Disclosure by Insiders and national registrant systems
finding: Insider holding changes versus filings require transaction codes, amendments and corporate actions; not an insider-trading allegation.

name: Ontario Securities Commission exempt-market distributions
finding: Exempt-distribution amounts are not comprehensive financial statements; full issuer filings required.

name: British Columbia MINFILE mineral occurrence database
finding: Mineral occurrence geology is not an economic reserve or proof of extraction; dated permits and technical reports required.

name: Québec geochemistry
finding: Geochemical samples require method, matrix, QA and location; concentrations cannot establish population exposure.

name: Office of the Information Commissioner of Canada decisions database
finding: Information orders need exact terms, service dates and court review/stay evidence before judging compliance.
